title: SignalCubeTemplatesRow
description: One Drain3 log template of one service, with per-window line counts and an error-level flag (03 §3.3). Written by Signalyth; template text and id cover the whole data range, only the count_* columns depend on alert windows.

service.description: Service whose logs the template was mined from.

template_id.description: "T" + first 8 hex of SHA-256(canonical_json([service, template])), ensure_ascii=False (short_id("T", 8, [service, template])).

template.description: Final Drain3 template text of the cluster, mined from masked first lines (the masked string itself if Drain3 fails).

count_baseline.description: Lines of the template with timestamps in alert.windows.baseline.

count_incident.description: Lines of the template with timestamps in alert.windows.incident.

error_level.description: True if any line of the template has severity ERROR/FATAL or its full body matches logs.error_lexicon.

first_seen_ns.description: Timestamp of the template's earliest line in the data range (ns).
